title: NashVegas City Retreat
description:
Decorated by HGTV designer, enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place within 1 mile of downtown Nashville.  The comfiest plush mattresses so rest up after you party hard.  
Family friendly, flat TV's in each bedroom and the living room, extra long bunk beds to accomodate adults, balcony with views of downtown, building amenities including rooftop deck and other common areas. Luxurious linens, toaster, blenders, dinnerware shot glasses and hosts with an eye for detail. Brand new!

The space
This property is a mile to the center of downtown on Broadway.  It's a brand new building with awesome an rooftop with downtown views. Ridiculously comfy beds (even the bunks) and a balcony so you can see the lights of music city at night!  Come and enjoy Nashville while also having a cool place to call home and entertain your friends and family.

Other things to note
We used to accept pets but unfortunately, one of our first guests kind of ruined that for the rest of ya.  Sorry.
